title: Concept: Session identifier kept across login
description: A login response that reuses the pre-authentication session identifier in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Reusing the identifier means an attacker who planted one before login holds the authenticated session afterwards, which is session fixation.
applicability: Deployments that render a login response that reuses the pre-authentication session identifier into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Reusing the identifier means an attacker who planted one before login holds the authenticated session afterwards, which is session fixation.
